coverage_exempt.reason: The hash-verified original assigns ESI=0 here only after operator new returns null, then unconditionally dereferences ESI at 0x4d6387 before any recoverable return or physical service. Ordinary returning cases cannot execute this two-byte assignment without an invalid null-object access. Keep the full owned body and its source null dereference; callback-null initialization failure and real destruction remain required returning coverage.

limits: Operator new is a controlled allocator because the original heap ultimately calls the operating system.
Operator delete is a controlled release paired with the allocator.
The lstrlenA import is supplied by cases with actual string-length behavior.
The InterlockedDecrement import is supplied by cases with actual 32-bit decrement behavior.
Cases provision valid state-name and handler-array storage to keep original callees away from CRT reallocation and diagnostic OS paths.
notes: Owns the complete game registration entries only; 0x4c8160 and all state initializers remain original-backed callees. Legacy source files are retained separately and are not canonical evidence.
